english.title: Make false statement under Environmental Permitting regulations
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) made a statement in purported compliance with a requirement to provide information imposed by or under a provision of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016 which you knew to be, or recklessly made such a statement which was, false or misleading in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSEHOOD..)
